articles.title: Kindness of strangers: I was stranded, dressed as a flapper, on a freezing night. Then a cheerful taxi driver pulled over
articles.summary: My tyre was blown so he changed it for me. When I offered payment, he said ‘Don’t be ridiculous love’ I had to fight not to lose control of the car. I was in my early 20s and driving home from a fancy dress party when bang – my tyre suddenly blew.
body: It was 1982 in Canberra; a foggy, bitterly cold night in the middle of winter. I was wearing a silly flapper dress and high heels – I’m not sure I’d even packed a jacket! I had a spare tyre in the back, but little idea how to change it. My options were to make the one hour walk home alone or wait to see if another car passed and could offer me a ride. For 30 minutes I sat in the driver’s seat helplessly, unsure what to do.

The roads in Canberra were always empty at that hour. There was nothing in the way of public transport and taxis were rarer than hen’s teeth – New York City this was not! So it felt heaven sent when I eventually saw a taxi approach, light on to signal it was available.
I flagged the taxi down and asked for a ride home, explaining that I’d call a tow truck and come back for my car in the morning. He had another idea – and offered to change my tyre for me.

So in the middle of a freezing winter’s night, this cheerful, older taxi driver hopped out to change my tyre. He waited to see me drive off safely before leaving and refused my offer of payment for helping. I believe his words were: “Don’t be ridiculous, love!”

articles.title: Why Some Flights Were Exempt From the Ground Stop
articles.summary: Dozens of international flights departed from the United States during Friday’s nationwide ground stop. Some planes also left for Hawaii from the West Coast.
body: Thousands of passengers scrambled to update their travel plans on Saturday as air traffic slowly unsnarled after a nationwide ground stop on Friday, but a number of travelers had already arrived at their destinations on flights left unaffected by the order.

Dozens of international flights took to the skies even as airports across the United States coped with only the third nationwide ground stop issued by the Federal Aviation Administration this century. Certain flights were also permitted to depart from the West Coast to Hawaii during the stoppage.
Here’s why some air travel was allowed to proceed even as flight systems were hampered.
More than 8,200 flights were canceled nationwide on Friday — over 31 percent of those scheduled — according to Cirium, an aviation data firm.
points: Dozens of international flights departed from the United States during Friday’s nationwide ground stop.

articles.title: Why would anyone want a smart fridge? | Dave Schilling
articles.summary: After a hack in France, internet-enabled appliances are looking even less appealing – especially before the holidays. We are deep into the holiday season now, past Halloween and a mere two weeks away from American Thanksgiving.
body: I’ve already given up taking care of my body, surrendering fully to gluttony, vices, and going to bed at 7pm because it’s pitch black outside. I’ve begun to hibernate like a slothful bear, my blanket and pillow never too far from my grasp. The only thing closer to my hands than my bedsheets is a slice of cold pizza. I just want to eat in peace, thank you very much.
Grocery retailers are keen to take advantage of holiday-related binge eating, developing and releasing ever-more-depraved festive novelty foods to subdue us into carb-induced slumber.

In the UK, Marks & Spencer is expected to unleash hoards of weird, miniature packages of comical junk, affectionately known as “ picky bits ”, to prevent your digestive system from ever idling into park. “Ham and Barber’s Cheddar Crumpets”. “Twelve Mini Chicken Kyivs”. “British Melton Mowbray pork pie”. These dishes either sound like a thing a tertiary character orders in a Harry Potter novel or the last meal of a 60s British gangster.

articles.title: Gout is on the rise – and excruciating. Why are sufferers still judged for it?
articles.summary: About 1.6 million people in the UK have this agonising condition, but it is often viewed as a comical malady brought on by overconsumption and idleness. What can be done to end the stigma? Brett McAllister-Byrne was in his early 30s when he first noticed a sharp ache in his ankle and big toe.
body: “I was like, really?” he says. “Can you get that in your 30s?”

High urate levels can have many causes, but they are not, in themselves, the sole cause of gout. “Virtually all people with gout will have a raised urate level,” says consultant rheumatologist Prof Edward Roddy. “But most people with a raised urate level don’t get gout.”

The pain of a gout attack is so debilitating that it can be hard to describe: the 19th-century writer and clergyman Sydney Smith said it felt “like walking on my eyeballs”. “Sometimes people think they’ve broken a bone – that’s quite a common thing,” says Roddy. “There is some qualitative research showing that people compare the intensity of the pain to having a heart attack or a kidney stone, and that women with gout compare the intensity of the pain to childbirth.”

It can also arrive, in the first instance, with little or no warning. “Often it comes on overnight,” says Roddy. “So somebody goes to bed pain-free, then they wake up and can’t put their foot to the floor.”

articles.title: Katy Perry and Justin Trudeau Have Their Red Carpet Couple Style on Lock
articles.summary: Last night, the singer and former Canadian prime minister stepped out for the 2026 Baby2Baby Gala, proving they’re found their red carpet rhythm together.
body: Katy Perry and Justin Trudeau may have, at first, seemed like an unlikely pairing, but they have their red carpet style as a couple down to a fine art. The pop star and former Canadian prime minister are becoming regular fixtures on the event circuit, and while their respective wardrobes might come from very different worlds, they’ve found a winning formula: classic suits and tailoring for Trudeau, and a willingness to let Perry’s more maximalist fashion do the talking.

Last night, the couple attended the annual Baby2Baby Gala in Los Angeles. Perry wore a look from Antonio Grimaldi’s spring 2025 couture collection; she donned a strapless, silver sequined minidress layered over a floor-length champagne satin skirt, with a dramatic, sweeping cape falling from the back. She paired it with nude Paris Texas sandals, glittering earrings, and a sleek, flicked-out black bob. Trudeau, meanwhile, looked every inch her date in a white tuxedo jacket with satin lapels, black trousers, and a black bow tie.

articles.title: ‘I Love Being a Girl’: Inside the Life of a Sorority Influencer
articles.summary: Many young adults want to be influencers. And why not? It’s fun. But it also means that the camera is always on.
body: The Alpha Phi sorority house at the University of Arizona occupies a professionally decorated Spanish colonial-style mansion just off campus. There’s a chandeliered dining room, two pink-and-baby-blue living rooms and a tanning area on the roof.

It’s where Haley DeKreek, a 20-year-old junior, lives with her closest friends. It’s also the backdrop to her budding career. Her work takes place mostly in her room, but she picks up the rewards in the mailroom just off the foyer.

Perpetually suffused with floral perfume, it overflows with packages, many of them hers: boxes with dresses for formals or matching yoga sets, boxes of makeup, hair products and skin care. Some she ordered herself, but many are freebies from brands that have spotted her potential as a TikTok influencer, a one-girl campus marketing powerhouse. Nearly all are destined to appear in the many-stepped “get ready with me” videos she has posted since she was a first-year student rushing sororities.
points: But it also means that the camera is always on.

articles.summary: Shop the best wedding guest dresses for every kind of ceremony and dress code—from a garden wedding to a beach wedding and courthouse ceremony.
body: Once you’ve coordinated your wedding guest schedule, the next step is figuring out what to wear to all those nuptials. Between decoding dress codes (just how casual is a “casual” wedding, really?) and navigating different climates, you’ll quickly realize there’s no one-size-fits-all solution to this sort of occasion styling. So if you find yourself in the run-up to a fancy affair with a closet full of not-quite-right frocks and a looming deadline—don’t panic. We pulled together an edit of the best wedding guest dresses to suit every possible style, venue, and budget.
Whatever’s in the cards (we mean this literally—please read the invite carefully), our picks for the best wedding guest dresses cover a lot of ground.

The coldest days of the year come with the quandary of formal dressing for freezing temps (is there anything worse than having to cover a great dress with a puffer coat?). Stay warm in Staud’s long-sleeve maxi or a velvet option by Veronica Beard. Or, fully embrace winter glam in Simkhai’s halterneck gown, which has a low back for some drama.

articles.title: Walking the Peaks of the Balkans, a Trekking Route With Community At Its Core
articles.summary: The 119-mile inn-to-inn hiking route has reconnected mountain villages in Albania, Kosovo, and Montenegro, once splintered by war—and welcomed the world onto their doorstep.
body: I'm awoken by the sound of cowbells clanging outside my bare-boned wood cabin in Dobërdol, a high mountain settlement in northern Albania. Through the window, slightly fogged from the chilly morning air at 5,700 feet, I see the culprits: five chestnut-colored cows munching on grass just feet from my bedside, their bells and tails swinging away.

I make the short and frigid walk across the guesthouse lawn to the breakfast room, maneuvering around a dozen or so hikers' tents pitched in the grass. Yesterday’s 10-mile trek from Çerem to Dobërdol is still fresh in my mind: dusty dirt trails edged with wild blueberries I couldn’t resist picking and patches of willow gentian, their petals so intensely purple they matched the berry stains on my fingers. The forests of pine, beech, and spruce in these parts are thick enough that the daylight dims inside of them; the valleys dizzyingly deep as they fold in on themselves.
The Peaks of the Balkans trek is a 119-mile inn-to-inn circular trail across the long-disputed borderlands of Albania, Kosovo, and Montenegro.
Local-owned guesthouses welcome trekkers with included meals, like fresh vegetables, homemade dairy, and cured sausages and meats.
points: The 119-mile inn-to-inn hiking route has reconnected mountain villages in Albania, Kosovo, and Montenegro, once splintered by war—and welcomed the world onto their doorstep.

articles.title: Read Dodie Kazanjian’s In-Depth 1994 Richard Avedon Profile for Vogue
articles.summary: The photographer is the subject of a new documentary, “Avedon,” directed by Ron Howard.
body: “Avedon’s Eye,” by Dodie Kazanjian, was originally published in the February 1994 issue of Vogue.

Richard Avedon made four trips to Stockholm a few years ago to see Ingmar Bergman’s production of Long Day’s Journey into Night, in Swedish. He saw it seven times. “There’s no movie I could see seven times, but when a great living performance captures me, I could go every night, forever.... At the Royal Dramatic Theater in Stockholm, when you go upstairs for coffee during intermission, there’s a place on the ceiling where they have the masks of comedy and tragedy—and they’re both tragedy! Because you’re in Sweden. So it’s the perfect place for me, obviously.”

articles.title: All Accounted for After Tanker Crashes Into Docked New Orleans Riverboat
articles.summary: Gov. Jeff Landry of Louisiana called it a “literal miracle on the Mississippi” that all of the nearly 200 people aboard the riverboat were rescued.
body: A tanker ship struck a riverboat carrying nearly 200 people on Friday in New Orleans, causing the cruise ship to capsize at its dock and prompting a wide-scale search-and-rescue operation, the authorities said.
Mayor Helena Moreno of New Orleans said at a news conference that all passengers of the riverboat, the American Heritage, were accounted for after the crash.
A city of New Orleans spokesperson said on Friday that 32 people were hospitalized. On Saturday the city’s deputy mayor of health and human services said two people had serious injuries.
“It is a literal miracle on the Mississippi,” said Gov. Jeff Landry of Louisiana, who also spoke at the news conference.

articles.title: 5 Cozy Meals Our Editors Make With Boxed Stuffing
articles.summary: Like one-pan schmaltzy chicken and weeknight pasta with savory crumbs.
body: Each month in Well Stocked, our staff shares unfussy recipe ideas that you can call upon any day of the week. Because yes, our editors love to cook, but sometimes we need to get dinner on the table 12 minutes ago. That’s when we look to pantry and fridge staples that can quickly morph into delicious meals. This month, it’s all about boxed stuffing.

Few Thanksgiving dishes inspire as many strong opinions as stuffing slash dressing. In a baking dish or the bird itself? Sourdough or white bread? Fresh herbs or dried? Sausage or nah? There are the purists, who insist on drying their own bread, chopping aromatics, and seasoning everything from scratch. Then there are the Stove Top loyalists, who grew up on that unmistakable red box and remain fiercely faithful. Site director Rachel Tepper Paley is firmly in the latter camp. “My late father considered boxed Stove Top the Platonic ideal of stuffing, so I grew up with the uber-savory stuff on every Thanksgiving table,” she says. “We continue to serve it every year in his honor.”
